_comment: Joiners, movers and leavers for scripts/manage-users.mjs. No secrets here.
'who', 'reportsTo' and 'reassignTo' are matched against any text field on a
profile, so a username, a full name or an email all work; the email is the
safest when two people share a name.
Every TODO must be replaced before --apply will run.
